title: The Accusation of Beelzebul and the Parable of the Strong Man
description: Jesus drives out a demon that had made a man mute, and the crowd wonders. Some accuse him of casting out demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of evil spirits. Jesus answers that a kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and that if he casts out demons by God's finger, the kingdom of God has come upon them. He tells the parable of the strong man who is overcome by someone stronger.
